# ALOM

> ALOM is a comprehensive supply chain solutions and fulfillment services provider offering 3PL, contract manufacturing, inventory management, and logistics expertise.

ALOM operates a global supply chain network with facilities in Fremont, Sacramento, and Indianapolis, serving regulated industries with certified quality management, security compliance (HIPAA, GDPR, PCI DSS), and ESG sustainability practices. The company combines custom technology development with Six Sigma and Lean methodologies to deliver end-to-end supply chain excellence.

## Key Topics

- 3PL Services
- Supply Chain Management
- Contract Manufacturing
- Inventory Management
- Fulfillment Services
- Order Management

- Supply Chain Execution

## Core Services

- [3PL+ Services - ALOM Technologies](https://alom.com/services/3pl): ALOM 3PL+ services: fulfillment, order management, reverse logistics
- [Supply Chain Execution - ALOM Technologies](https://alom.com/services/supply-chain-execution): ALOM supply chain execution: sourcing, procurement, inventory, delivery
- [Light Contract Manufacturing - ALOM Technologies](https://alom.com/services/light-contract-manufacturing): ALOM contract manufacturing: medical device assembly, kitting, compliance
- [Full Service E-commerce and E-fulfillment Services by ALOM](https://alom.com/solutions-services/ecommerce-efulfillment): ALOM e-commerce fulfillment: inventory, returns, order management
- [Reverse Logistics Company: Seamless Returns by ALOM](https://alom.com/solutions-services/reverse-logistics-company): ALOM reverse logistics: returns management, refurbishment, recycling
- [Kitting Services: On Demand Production and Assembly by ALOM](https://alom.com/solutions-services/kitting): ALOM kitting services: assembly, medical compliance, Six Sigma quality
- [Global Inventory Management Supplier | ALOM Technology](https://alom.com/solutions-services/inventory-management-vendor): ALOM inventory management: VMI, COMPASS platform, demand planning
